skill.displayName: Work Productivity Gog Google Workflow Helper

llm.summary: This looks like a Google Workspace/Gog workflow helper, but it can be invoked too easily around sensitive mail, calendar, and Drive tasks.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose appears aligned with Google Workspace/Gog workflow assistance, where Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and CLI guidance are expected, but those domains involve sensitive user data and possible account mutations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The supplied artifact evidence shows broad trigger terms and examples across SKILL/README/reference files, plus implicit invocation in agents/openai.yaml, which makes accidental activation plausible for generic Google, workspace, workflow, checklist, analysis, or help requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No VirusTotal telemetry was supplied and the scanner evidence provided does not show hidden installers, obfuscated setup, or unexpected package execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Google Workspace access is proportionate for this purpose when explicitly requested, but the activation scope should be narrowed because the affected environment can include private email, calendar, and files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The supplied evidence does not show background persistence, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, or unrelated long-running workers.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want agent help with Gog/Google Workspace workflows. Before use, narrow or disable implicit activation where possible and require explicit confirmation before sending mail, changing calendar events, editing Drive/Sheets/Docs data, or using OAuth-authenticated accounts.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted as a Review-level scope concern: Google Workspace keywords are expected for this kind of helper, but the reported standalone broad keywords, vague examples, and implicit invocation are under-scoped for a skill that may affect Gmail, Calendar, and Drive workflows. This does not show malware, exfiltration, or destructive intent.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Downgraded to a minor documentation issue: mixed-language activation text can confuse users about when the skill applies, but it is not direct evidence of unsafe execution or credential misuse.
